About PHASIS

PHASIS is a science-backed performance and longevity brand built on a simple belief: Humans are made to evolve.

We create premium products, practical systems, and educational content that help people improve performance, recovery, hydration, and long-term health. Every product is built with quality, transparency, and evidence at its foundation.

Our Products

Performance

  • Perform+ – Premium β-Ecdysterone to support lean muscle development, strength adaptations, recovery, and athletic performance.

Hydration

  • Electro+ – Flavorless electrolyte concentrate with 50+ naturally derived trace minerals to support hydration, endurance, recovery, and cognitive performance.

Recovery

  • Max Relief – Daily recovery support designed to help active individuals recover, move, and perform at their best.

  • Relief Balm – Fast-acting topical support for sore muscles, joints, and post-workout recovery.

What Makes PHASIS Different

Most brands sell supplements.

PHASIS builds systems.

We combine science, practical protocols, and thoughtful education to help people become stronger, healthier, and more capable. Our goal isn't simply to sell products—it's to help people build better habits, make better decisions, and perform at a higher level.

We're looking for partners who educate, inspire, and create authentic content that genuinely helps people.

How You Earn

Partners earn commission on every qualifying purchase made through their unique referral link or discount code.

As the PHASIS Partner Program grows, top-performing partners may receive:

  • Increased commission rates

  • Exclusive discount codes

  • Early access to new product launches

  • Product seeding opportunities

  • Ambassador partnerships

  • Featured collaborations and campaigns

How to Promote PHASIS

We encourage educational, authentic content over traditional advertising.

Examples include:

  • Product demonstrations

  • Training and recovery routines

  • Hydration and performance tips

  • Science-backed education

  • Lifestyle and wellness content

  • Honest product reviews

  • Daily protocols and habits

We'll provide creative assets, product information, and ongoing support to help you create content that aligns with the PHASIS brand.

Join the PHASIS Partner Program

PHASIS is building more than a supplement company—we're building a community committed to better performance, better health, and intentional human evolution.

If you're passionate about helping people become stronger, healthier, and more capable, we'd love to partner with you.

Made to Evolve.
